description: This file defines a utility support module for voice wake recognition debugging, including functions for logging transcripts, matching wake words, summarizing transcripts, and formatting match results.

classes.name: TranscriptSummary
classes.description: A simple data structure holding whether the transcript is text-only and its timing count.

methods.name: shouldLogTranscript
methods.description: Determines whether a transcript should be logged based on the logger level, transcript content, and timing constraints.

methods.name: textOnlyFallbackMatch
methods.description: Attempts to create a wake word match based on text-only criteria and a provided command trimming function.

methods.name: transcriptSummary
methods.description: Creates a summary for a given transcript, triggers, and segments, indicating if it's text-only and counting segments.

methods.name: matchSummary
methods.description: Formats a wake word match object into a descriptive string.
